instruction: Build a login screen following my conventions: a full-screen branded background image, a vertically centered translucent form card (max width 400), Customer ID and password fields with labels, and an elevated LOGIN button.

Create a password text field with a visibility toggle, following my text field conventions: the brand border is always on and never restyled on focus, rounded corners, light blue fill, and a 14px bold label.
Convert this button to my button style: always elevated (pushed-up look), brand cyan background, dark grey text. Never flat, never outlined.
output:
ElevatedButton(
  onPressed: () {},
  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
    backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4AC9E3),
    foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF353535),
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
    ),
    elevation: 2,
  ),
  child: const Text(
    'SUBMIT',
    style: TextStyle(
      fontSize: 16,
      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
      letterSpacing: 0.5,
    ),
  ),
)

instruction: Build a sign-up screen reusing my login page patterns: full-screen branded background image, vertically centered translucent card, name / email / password / confirm-password fields, and an elevated SIGN UP button.
Build a registration form (username, password, confirm password) following my conventions. It must not flutter when tapping between fields.
Fix this form — it flutters when tapping between the fields because each field uses a different keyboard layout. Follow my convention: one keyboard type across the whole form.
input:
TextFormField(
  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
  textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
),
TextFormField(
  keyboardType: TextInputType.visiblePassword,
  obscureText: true,
  textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
),

instruction: Build a feedback screen with a movable panel following my conventions: it has a text field and a SEND button; when the keyboard opens I can drag the panel up in Y so the button stays reachable; when the keyboard closes it pins back to its centered position.
Convert this screen to my movable panel pattern: the keyboard covers the button and there is no way to reveal it. Keep the brand image background full-screen.

Build an action button following my conventions: tapping it submits a defect claim to an API. Show a spinner inside the button while the work runs, disable the button, and only navigate to the review screen if the API result requires it.

Build a navigation button following my conventions: tapping it immediately opens the order history screen, which shows a white background with a centered spinner while its data loads, then displays the orders.

Build an app shell following my conventions: the system status bar (time, signal, wifi, battery) is always visible, its background matches the header color, and the icon brightness adapts to whether the header is dark or light.
Fix this screen to follow my convention: the status bar must always be visible (time, signal, wifi, battery). It currently hides it in immersive mode.
